line_times: Good morning. This is Diane Lee with your local news. Starting Monday, Oak Street will be closed between First and Fifth Avenue. Workers are going to replace an old water pipe under the street.
The city says the construction might take two weeks. It may take longer if it rains.

During the road closure, the number twelve bus will take a detour on Pine Street. Riders should expect delays of about fifteen minutes. The city will post updates on its website. I'm Diane Lee, and that's the news.
Later that morning, at work, Marco and Joy talk about the news.
Joy, did you hear the news? They're closing Oak Street on Monday.
Oh no. I take the number twelve bus on Oak Street every day.
The bus is going to take a detour on Pine Street. It might be fifteen minutes late.
Fifteen minutes? I might be late for work. Do you know when the bus leaves Pine Street?
I'm not sure. You could check the city website.
Good idea. Do you know how long the closure is?
They said two weeks. But it might take longer if it rains.
Hmm. Maybe I'll take the earlier bus. I don't want to be late.
Or I could give you a ride. I drive past your street.
Really? That would be great. Do you know where the detour starts?
I think it starts at First Avenue. I'm going to look at the map tonight.
